svg.title: How PrefillAdder admits requests
svg.desc: 4 · new_token_ratio decays, so the reservation shrinks
svg.text: 4 · new_token_ratio decays, so the reservation shrinks
KV pool slots of one GPU · page_size 1
Every decode step lowers new_token_ratio by the same amount, down to 0.7 × 0.14 ≈ 0.1 after 600 steps.
The reserve shrinks while memory lasts, so Y now fits.
